wantoks: dance of resilience…

role
mix · music · sound design

“WANTOKS: Dance of Resilience in Melanesia” – a short, gripping documentary about the fight for independence and dealing with the detrimental effects of climate change. A very involving project for me – composed the music, and did the sound design, editing and final mix.
